page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c7se.xlarge is an enhanced compute instance powered by an Intel Xeon 8369B processor operating at 2.9 GHz. Based on the x86_64 architecture and virtualized via KVM, the instance provides 4 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 2 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. System resources include 8.0 GB of memory, yielding 2.0 GB per vCPU, alongside 48 MB of L3 cache and a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps. The instance lacks local storage drives and discrete GPU accelerators. Instruction set capabilities include AVX-512, AVX512_VNNI, AES, VAES, and SHA_NI.

Benchmark results demonstrate consistent single-threaded compute output alongside moderate memory and multi-core throughput. Single-core evaluations, including stress-ng single-core (1883.99), Geekbench single-core (1556.0), and PassMark encryption tests, fall within average baseline tiers. Conversely, multi-core benchmarks show lower relative scaling, with Geekbench multi-core scoring 3343.0 and stress-ng multi-core scoring 3871.28. Uncached memory read bandwidth reaches 30.35 GB/sec, while write operations peak at 25.29 GB/sec.

With a 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, the hardware configuration prioritizes vCPU density over memory capacity. This allocation profile suits workloads requiring dedicated execution threads without intensive RAM footprints, such as static web serving, lightweight single-threaded processing, small software compilations, and basic microservice hosting.
